name: industrial-telemetry
description: Industrial telemetry — PWA dashboard with Express + MQTT + Ory Kratos + Angular 22 + PrimeNG

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.docker:yc:up: npm run build:client && docker compose -f docker-compose.yc.yml --env-file .env.yc up -d
scripts.docker:yc:build: npm run build:client && docker compose -f docker-compose.yc.yml build --no-cache
